description: This file defines the MyCallsDashlet class, which extends DashletGeneric, providing a custom dashboard widget for displaying 'Calls' related data in a SugarCRM/SuiteCRM environment. It includes initialization, processing, and display configuration logic specific to 'My Calls' functionality.

classes.name: MyCallsDashlet
classes.description: A dashboard widget class for displaying user's calls, extending the generic dashlet class with custom processing and display options.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the dashlet with configurations, loading data definitions, setting labels, columns, and seed bean.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Processes and retrieves call data for display, including filtering, handling appointment acceptance status, and formatting durations.

methods.name: displayOptions
methods.description: Prepares and returns the configuration options interface for customizing the dashlet.
